# `base64` standard library

The `base64` module implements RFC 4648 Section 4 standard Base64 (`+`, `/`, `=`
padding) and Section 5 URL/filename-safe Base64URL (`-`, `_`, unpadded or padded).

```{.dva .run}
#use base64
#use io

enc = base64::encode("hello world")
io::out $ enc
base64::decode(enc) | dec => io::out $ dec
```

## Function catalog

| Symbol / Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `base64::encode(s)` | `String => String` | Encodes `s` using standard RFC 4648 Base64 (`+`, `/`) with `=` padding |
| `base64::decode(s)` | `String => < String | Error >` | Decodes standard Base64 (ignoring ASCII whitespace); returns `Error` on invalid characters or quantum lengths |
| `base64::encode_url(s)` | `String => String` | Encodes `s` using URL-safe RFC 4648 Section 5 Base64URL (`-`, `_`) without `=` padding |
| `base64::encode_url_padded(s)` | `String => String` | Encodes `s` using URL-safe Base64URL (`-`, `_`) with `=` padding |
| `base64::decode_url(s)` | `String => < String | Error >` | Decodes URL-safe Base64URL (accepts both padded and unpadded inputs) |
